title.en: Can you hear sounds in space?

content.zh: 不能哦！太空里几乎没有空气，是个大真空（Vacuum）。因为声音需要空气来传播，所以太空里是绝对安静的，宇航员交流都要靠无线电！
content.en: No! Space is almost completely empty, creating a Vacuum. Because sound needs air to travel, space is absolutely silent. Astronauts have to use radios to talk to each other!

title.zh: 宇航员在太空怎么睡觉
title.en: How do astronauts sleep in space?

content.zh: 在太空里因为没有重力（Microgravity），宇航员会飘起来！所以他们必须钻进固定在墙上的睡袋里，就像被绑在床上的小气球，这样才不会在睡觉时飘走。
content.en: Because there is Microgravity in space, astronauts float! They must zip themselves into sleeping bags attached to the wall, like little balloons tied to a bed, so they don't float away while sleeping.

title.en: Does the moon make its own light?

content.zh: 不会哦！月亮其实像一面大镜子，它自己没有光，我们看到的月光，其实是它反射（Reflection）了太阳的光。
content.en: No! The moon is actually like a giant mirror. It doesn't have its own light; the moonlight we see is just sunlight reflecting off its surface.

title.en: The eight planets in our solar system

content.zh: 我们住在地球上，太阳系里还有七个行星小伙伴！按离太阳从近到远的顺序，它们分别是：水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星和海王星。
content.en: We live on Earth, and there are seven other planet friends in our solar system! From closest to farthest from the Sun, they are: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.

title.zh: 宇航员在太空怎么喝水
title.en: How do astronauts drink water in space?

content.zh: 在太空里，水不会乖乖待在杯子里，而是会变成一个个飘浮的水球（Water Droplets）！宇航员需要像吃糖果一样，把飘过来的水球“啊呜”一口吞进嘴里。
content.en: In space, water doesn't stay in a cup; it forms floating Water Droplets! Astronauts have to catch the floating water balls and eat them like candy!
